instruction: How to configure IKEv1 Aggressive Mode in strongSwan
output:
<think>
We should configure IKEv1 Aggressive Mode in strongSwan.
A quick sanity check afterward saves debugging time later.
</think>
echo 'connections {
  ikev1-agg {
    version = 1
    aggressive = yes
    local_addrs = 192.168.1.10
    remote_addrs = 192.168.2.10
    local {
      auth = psk
      id = server
    }
    remote {
      auth = psk
      id = participant
    }
    children {
      net {}
    }
  }
}' >> /etc/swanctl/swanctl.conf
